note: M2 milestone F (designed, centered): standout plays. A player is elite for a kind when his card rating (the league pool after the team-strength shift, before home field) for any of the kind's ratings is at least `threshold` and he plays one of its positions. On a play the kind applies to, each elite on-field player's multiplier enters the boosted class's weight, weighted by his base share of the role (participants.json, before class tilts): factor = centering x (1 + sum of share x (multiplier - 1)). Below the threshold a player adds nothing (the factor before centering is exactly 1). `centering` is set so the factor averages 1 over the in-sample leagues' plays the kind applies to (scripts/game/standouts.ts --center), so league class rates stay where they are. A play is a standout only when the factor was applied, the boosted class was drawn and the elite player is the one credited with the role; crediting then weights an elite candidate by his multiplier. Kinds, threshold and the F2 minimum are pre-registered in data/game/m2-standout-tolerances.json. `enabled` is what the game uses (prepareGame; off until the lead turns it on, docs/DECISIONS.md M2 F); createEngine alone runs with standouts off.
